behaviors.description: Three individually named emissive sphere visitors repeat distinct pool laps, wade-and-rest and lazy-river circuits using authored waterpark pool bounds. Nearby forward-facing T presses cycle authored dialogue. Movement and dialogue timers advance only with normal gameplay; session close removes owned Entities and Audicles. Emission is a fixed vertex-color appearance with no dynamic lighting or light contribution.
behaviors.selection: NpcSystem enabled during Mirror planet navigation. Initial scripted aquatic routines only; general town pathfinding, slide queues, collision agents, schedules and character models remain future work.

checks.expectation: Independent bounded continuous loops, dwell, pause, dialogue edge/range checks and complete repeated-close cleanup. Three visitors fit alongside all existing scene instances.
checks.procedure: Run NPC unit and registered host lifecycle tests, scene capacity test and intent inspection. Native waterpark appearance and T interaction require separate visual review.
